purpose: Compile deterministic inspectable 3D scene state into a self-contained AXM-owned WebGL2 visual runtime without requiring an external creative application.

properties.scene: AXM native visual scene object; required for compile and bundle
properties.path: caller-selected output directory outside the protected live machine body; required for bundle and demo

contains: portable native scene state that optional external adapters may consume

relationships: is an AXM-owned visual execution path and remains available when external creative tools are absent
may share camera, transforms, basic material values, lights and world state with optional external adapters
keeps browser pixel observation separate from deterministic source compilation and JavaScript syntax evidence
refuses silent writes into non-empty output directories unless replace is explicit
does not classify Blender-backed or other third-party execution as native
limitations: the native renderer currently supports boxes, spheres, cylinders and planes rather than arbitrary imported meshes
WebGL2 execution and rendered visual quality require browser or authorized host evidence
native geometry, rigging, texturing, simulation and rendering breadth is still substantially smaller than mature external creative suites
optional external adapters may currently provide capabilities the native runtime has not implemented yet, but those adapters remain external dependencies rather than native AXM capability

truth.basis: Compiled scene state, hashes, generated source, absent host pixels and external-tool execution remain explicitly distinguishable.

agency.basis: The caller selects the operation, scene, output path and replacement choice; the runtime is self-contained and makes no network calls.

continuity.basis: The scene JSON is deterministic, inspectable and remains usable without any third-party creative executable.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Schema validation, bounded scene size, deterministic hashing, source checks and explicit host evidence gates precede visual-quality claims.
